scripts.dev: npm run seed && concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green --kill-others "npm run dev -w @shop/api" "npm run dev -w @shop/web"
scripts.test:unit: npm run test:unit -w @shop/web && npm run test:unit -w @shop/api
scripts.test:integration: npm run test:integration -w @shop/web && npm run test:integration -w @shop/api
scripts.smoke: npm run typecheck && npm run test:unit && npm run test:integration
